description:
## ⚡ RJ-patches v1.2.0 Release

### 🎙️ Local TTS Patches Included
- **Local TTS Pro**: Unlocks local Pro features (full-length reader, all voices, and audio export) by overriding the shared Pro entitlement state mapping (com.umberlab.local.tts v1.2.1).

### 🎬 MovieBox Patches Included
- **Fix Video Buffering & Smooth Streaming**: Overrides Media3 / ExoPlayer buffer window (minBuffer = 50s, maxBuffer = 300s, bufferForPlaybackAfterRebuffer = 15s), raises HTTP connection/read timeout to 30s, and enables aggressive 1GB Aliyun memory caching to eliminate playback stuttering and freezing.
- **Unlock High Quality (VIP Resolution)**: Removes resolution cap on 720p/1080p/4K streams across all MovieBox variants.
- **Premium Unlock**: Enables VIP player options and removes playback restrictions.
- **Remove Ads**: Strips in-app interstitial banners, startup splash ads, and preroll advertisements.

### 📷 GPS Map Camera Patches Included
- **Premium Unlocked**: Neutralizes PairIP licensing & anti-tamper, unlocks Pro VIP lifetime licenses, removes watermarks, and silences ad placements (com.gpsmapcamera.geotagginglocationonphoto v1.9.40).

### 📦 Installation in Morphe Manager
Add this repository URL in Morphe Manager sources:
`
https://gitlab.com/rudrakshrajpurohit417/rj-patches
`
